parsed.why: Statewide binary-sex statute barring gender-congruent use of bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters, dormitories and prisons; no anti-discrimination recourse, religious-refusal immunity, worst-tier assessment, no remedy documented in practice.

Enforced public-accommodations anti-discrimination covering hotels and transport, GI hate-crime penalties, care shield for travellers, open IDs, panic-defence bar; only the shared national border/custody layer pulls it down.

Shield law, comprehensive care coverage, court-ordered prison care, most-protective tier; but documented birth-sex housing used as prison discipline and unresolved anti-trans ballot measures, under the national passport/entry layer.

No bathroom, sex-definition or adult-care restriction; hostile bills vetoed. But no statewide gender-identity anti-discrimination or GI hate-crime coverage, so recourse for service denial or violence is thin.

Binary-sex statute, school-to-college bathroom bans, felony youth-care ban, judicially upheld surgery-only ID rule, no GI protections or hate-crime coverage; harshest-law grouping, lowest public support.
